objective7_denominatorDefinitions.dbInteraction: Any invocation of pool.query, client.query, pool.connect, or transactionManager in application code.
objective7_denominatorDefinitions.sqlCallSite: A call site executing a parameterized or raw SQL query string against PostgreSQL.
objective7_denominatorDefinitions.stage0RlsSqlCallSite: An SQL call site whose query target is one of the 33 Stage-0 RLS tables.
objective7_denominatorDefinitions.write: An SQL execution performing INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE on database records.
objective7_denominatorDefinitions.read: An SQL execution performing SELECT on database records, or non-mutation query helper.
objective7_denominatorDefinitions.transactionControl: An SQL execution issuing BEGIN, COMMIT, or ROLLBACK commands to manage transaction boundaries.
